description: This file defines the Comment controller class for the CMS module in an OpenCart-based e-commerce system. It manages displaying, listing, replying to, adding, and rating comments associated with articles, including handling user permissions, tokens for security, and integrating with models and views.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class handling comment functionalities such as viewing, listing, replying, adding, and rating comments for articles in the CMS module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the comment page view with article information, sorting options, captcha, and user login status.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of comments by invoking the getList method.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and returns a paginated list of comments for a specified article, including reply information and pagination controls.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Outputs the replies to a specific comment.

methods.name: getReplies
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of reply comments to a parent comment, with pagination.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles adding a new comment or reply to an article, with security checks, validation, and spam/anti-spam handling.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Allows a logged-in user to rate (like/dislike) a specific comment and updates the ratings accordingly.
